interpretation: With known primitive/entity correspondences, ordinary Procrustes/Kabsch recovery already solves rigid geometric preservation essentially exactly in this synthetic setting.
A spectral-phase mechanism is therefore not justified for ordinary rigid persistent-entity edits.
Phase remains scientifically interesting only where correspondence is absent/unstable under split, merge, prune or densification, and it must then beat simpler correspondence-free geometry baselines.
decision: DEMOTE phase from flagship candidate. Retain only as a narrow correspondence-free/resampling hypothesis.
